mechanics.claim: Demon Shade heals only while active (out of combat, below threshold), affecting survivability but not applicable to a target dummy that fights back.
mechanics.quote: While [[Combat status|out of combat]], {{ci|Evelynn}} gains ''Demon Shade''.

mechanics.claim: Attacking or casting abilities ends Demon Shade immediately.
mechanics.quote: Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Demon Shade'' immediately and places it on a 4-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}

mechanics.claim: From level 6 onward, Demon Shade grants camouflage (not a damage/survival stat).
